draft.title: The changing religious pattern
card: Religious affiliation means the religion a person says they belong to. In the Australian census, people can also tick "no religion".
After 1945, migration from more places brought more religions. Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism and Sikhism grew, so Australia became more religiously diverse.
The share of Australians who say they are Christian has fallen over time. Christianity is still the religion that the largest number of Australians report.
The share reporting no religion has risen sharply. This group is made up of people who do not affiliate with any religion.
draft.remember: Since 1945, Australia has become more diverse, with fewer people reporting Christianity and more reporting no religion.

a.q: Which change in Australia since 1945 is a result of migration from more places?
opts: More religions are now practised across Australia
Fewer people now choose to answer the census
Christianity is no longer the largest religion
Most people have moved from cities to rural areas
a.why: Migrants from more places brought their own religions, so Australia became more religiously diverse. Christianity is still the largest reported religion, so saying it is no longer the largest is wrong.
a.clue: Think about what people bring with them when they move.

b.q: A census shows the share of Christians in a town fell from 80% to 60%, and the share reporting no religion rose from 10% to 25%. Which conclusion fits the figures?
opts: Christians are still the largest group, but their share fell
No religion has replaced Christianity as the largest group
Migration alone caused the fall in the Christian share
Fewer people left religion, so the town is less diverse
b.why: At 60%, Christians are still the largest group, though their share has fallen. The figures do not show that migration caused the fall, and no religion at 25% has not overtaken Christianity.
b.clue: Compare the new figures for each group, not just the change.

a.best: More religions are now practised across Australia

b.best: Christians are still the largest group, but their share fell
